Hi Marissa / Dylan,

Thanks for the quick intro. Acme's security team would like to schedule a technical architecture review to go over SOC 2 evidence mapping, encryption-at-rest/in-transit, audit logging, and SSO integration. Goal is to validate controls before our procurement team signs off.

High-level asks:
- Walkthrough of service boundaries and data flow for customer workloads
- Where keys are managed and encryption schemes used
- Audit log retention and exportability (we'll need sample extracts)
- SSO integration (SAML/OIDC) and provisioning options

Our availability next week: Tue 5/19 afternoon (PDT), Wed 5/20 morning, or Thu 5/21 anytime. Prefer a 60-90 minute deep-dive with your engineering/security lead.

Attached is our SOC 2 questionnaire (SOC2-questions.xlsx) - it has a few items we'd like to cover live.

Thanks,
James Porter
Senior Security Engineer | Acme Corp
james.porter@acme.com

1) Can you confirm the list of Acme systems/accounts that will be in scope for evidence collection (prod vs non-prod, any third-party connectors)?
2) Please share any specific SOC 2 questions from the questionnaire you want us to prioritize (page numbers or line items helps).
